notes.title: Patch v1.1.14 hotfix
notes.content: Updated the linux repositories to change where libsteam_api.so is placed in the manifest to avoid an error.

notes.title: Patch v1.1.14
notes.content:
This is a patch to address potential issues with Anagrams granting achievements discussed here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1345940/discussions/0/592883708946609316/

Thanks fauxRIOT for notifying us of this issue!

notes.title: Tiny patch for Linux
notes.content:
Hello! This patch fixes a start up bug caused by the last update for Linux users only. 

Thank you to Mikhail_SaTuRn for reporting this!

notes.title: Patch v1.1.14
notes.content:
Hello! This patch changes the Puzzle Master & Anagram Master achievements from needing 1000 puzzles/anagrams to needing all the puzzles/anagrams in Classic Mode to be completed. It also adds additional checks to grant achievements that may have been missed due to this bug.

Thank you to user James & Michelle for lettings us know about this issue!

notes.title: Fixed steamworks issue
notes.content: Fixed an issue caused by Steamworks middleware

notes.title: v.1.0.5
notes.content:
This patch updates Anagrams to v.1.0.5

Bug Fixes:
* Finishing the a puzzle would send the player to the categories screen instead of the anagrams screen if all categories were unlocked

notes.title: v1.0.4
notes.content: * Fixed a bug where the game would error while matching tiles for a puzzle

notes.title: v1.0.3 update notes
notes.content:
Fixed an bug that could prevent players from getting the 'UNLOCKED' achievement.
Fixed a bug that could prevent swapping tiles after retrying a puzzle.
Fixed a bug that prevented players from clicking the 'back', 'help' or 'play' buttons if they had unlocked all categories and finished enough levels to get granted another key.
